questions.q: What is the primary architectural advantage of using local durable storage files like questions.json over volatile databases on cloud platforms like Render?
questions.a: It eliminates the need for any frontend CSS frameworks
questions.b: It ensures configuration persistence across server restarts and redeploys without external database dependencies
questions.c: It automatically compresses image assets to save bandwidth
questions.d: It encrypts user passwords using quantum computing keys
questions.explanation: Durable JSON storage files committed directly to GitHub persist across ephemeral container restarts on cloud hosting providers like Render.

questions.q: What security action is automatically triggered if a student switches tabs or loses browser window focus during an active proctored exam?
questions.a: A temporary 30-second pause in the exam timer
questions.b: An immediate warning email sent to the university dean
questions.c: An automatic 0% score violation flag for anti-cheat enforcement
questions.explanation: Strict proctoring rules mandate an immediate 0% score violation flag to maintain exam integrity against tab-switching.

questions.q: How does the Ezrelyn system handle question and option security during high-stakes student evaluations?
questions.a: By hiding all correct answers from the server-side code completely
questions.b: By dynamically shuffling both questions and multiple-choice options (a, b, c, d) on every student attempt
questions.c: By locking the browser into full-screen mode permanently via native system calls
questions.d: By requiring biometric fingerprint verification before every click
questions.explanation: Random shuffling of questions and choices prevents cheating and memorization across multiple attempts.
